title: Attribute Production and Biased Technical Change in Automobiles
Distributional Consequences of Policies for Electric Heat Conversion
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We study the adoption of air-source heat pumps for home heating. We estimate that 5% of already-built homes converted to heat pumps during 2010–20, while 22% of new homes built during this period chose heat pumps. New adoptions concentrate among rural households in the South. Conversions are more diffuse, covering urban and rural households in every region. Conversions are more prevalent in areas with mild winters and cheap electricity relative to other fuels but are less strongly associated with energy costs than adoptions in new homes. To better understand the distributional implications going forward, we calculate the annual energy-cost savings from switching to a heat pump for a large sample of US households based on their current heating fuels, climate, and local energy prices. We find massive variation, with low-income households in the Northeast and Appalachians benefiting the most.
abstract_zh: 我们研究家庭供暖中空气源热泵的采用情况。我们估计，2010至2020年间，已建成住房中有5%改用了热泵，而同期新建住房中有22%选择了热泵。新增采用主要集中在美国南部的农村家庭。改造式采用则较为分散，覆盖各地区的城市和农村家庭。在冬季温和、且电力相对于其他燃料较便宜的地区，改造式采用更为普遍，但与新建住房的采用相比，改造式采用与能源成本的关联较弱。为了更好地理解未来的分配效应，我们基于大量美国家庭当前的供暖燃料、气候和当地能源价格，计算了改用热泵每年可节省的能源成本。我们发现存在巨大差异，东北部和阿巴拉契亚地区的低收入家庭获益最多。

title: What Do Consumers Believe About Future Gasoline Prices?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: A full understanding of how gasoline prices affect consumer behavior frequently requires information on how consumers forecast future gasoline prices. We provide the first evidence on the nature of these forecasts by analyzing two decades of data on gasoline price expectations from the Michigan Survey of Consumers. We find that average consumer beliefs are typically indistinguishable from a no-change forecast, justifying an assumption commonly made in the literature on consumer valuation of energy efficiency. We also provide evidence on circumstances in which consumer forecasts are likely to deviate from no-change and on significant cross-consumer forecast heterogeneity.
abstract_zh: 要全面理解汽油价格如何影响消费者行为，往往需要了解消费者如何预测未来的汽油价格。我们通过分析密歇根消费者调查二十年来的汽油价格预期数据，首次提供了关于这些预测性质的证据。我们发现，消费者的平均信念通常与不变预测（no-change forecast）无法区分，这为文献中关于消费者对能源效率估价的常见假设提供了依据。我们还提供了证据，说明消费者预测在哪些情形下可能偏离不变预测，以及消费者之间预测存在显著异质性。

title: Diversify or Focus? Spending to Combat Infectious Diseases When Budgets Are Tight
The Demand for Ethanol as a Gasoline Substitute
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper estimates household preferences for ethanol as a gasoline substitute.I develop a theoretical model linking the shape of the ethanol demand curve to the distribution of price ratios at which individual households switch fuels.I estimate the model using data from many retail fueling stations. Demand is price-sensitive with a mean elasticity of 2.5-3.5.I find that preferences are heterogeneous with many households willing to pay a premium for ethanol. This reduces the simulated cost of an ethanol content standard, since some households choose ethanol without large subsidies; simulated costs are still high relative to likely environmental benefits.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了家庭对乙醇作为汽油替代品的偏好。我构建了一个理论模型，将乙醇需求曲线的形状与单个家庭转换燃料所对应的价格比分布联系起来。我利用来自众多零售加油站的数据对该模型进行了估计。需求对价格敏感，平均需求弹性为2.5至3.5。我发现偏好具有异质性，许多家庭愿意为乙醇支付溢价。这降低了乙醇含量标准的模拟成本，因为一些家庭无需大量补贴即可选择乙醇；不过，相对于可能的环境效益，模拟成本仍然很高。

title: Let Them Eat Switchgrass? Modeling the Displacement of Existing Food Crops by New Bioenergy Feedstocks
Automobile Fuel Economy Standards: Impacts, Efficiency, and Alternatives
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy
abstract: This paper discusses fuel economy regulations in the United States and other countries. We first describe how these programs affect the automobile market, including their impacts on fuel use and other dimensions of the vehicle fleet. We then review different methodologies for assessing the costs of fuel economy regulations and discuss what the results of these methodologies imply for policy. Following that, we compare the welfare effects of fuel economy regulations to those of fuel taxes and assess whether or not these two policies can be complements. Finally, we review arguments for transitioning away from fuel economy regulations towards a "feebate" system.
abstract_zh: 本文讨论了美国及其他国家的燃油经济性法规。我们首先描述这些计划如何影响汽车市场，包括它们对燃料使用以及车队其他方面的影响。随后，我们回顾了评估燃油经济性法规成本的不同方法，并讨论这些方法的结果对政策意味着什么。接着，我们比较了燃油经济性法规与燃油税的福利效应，并评估这两种政策是否可以互补。最后，我们梳理了从燃油经济性法规转向“费税结合”（feebate）制度的理由。

title: Forecasting Gasoline Prices Using Consumer Surveys
abstract: This paper analyzes the predictive power of a new data set of consumer gasoline price forecasts taken from the Michigan Survey of Consumers (MSC). MSC data generally perform as well as a no-change forecast in predicting future gasoline prices, and they substantially out-perform the no-change forecast during the recent economic crisis, during which time they track futures market prices. Finally, the cross-respondent dispersion of the MSC forecasts increases substantially during the economic crisis, paralleling the large increase in price volatility at this time.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了一组取自密歇根消费者调查（MSC）的新数据集中消费者汽油价格预测的预测能力。在预测未来汽油价格方面，MSC数据总体上与不变预测表现相当；而在近期的经济危机期间，它们显著优于不变预测，并且其走势与期货市场价格相吻合。最后，在经济危机期间，MSC预测在受访者之间的离散程度大幅上升，这与同期价格波动的大幅上升相呼应。

title: Using Loopholes to Reveal the Marginal Cost of Regulation: The Case of Fuel-Economy Standards
abstract: Estimating the cost of regulation is difficult. Firms sometimes reveal costs indirectly, however, when they exploit loopholes to avoid regulation. We apply this insight to fuel economy standards for automobiles. These standards feature a loophole that gives automakers a bonus when they equip a vehicle with flexible-fuel capacity. Profit-maximizing automakers will equate the marginal cost of compliance using the loophole, which is observable, with the unobservable costs of strategies that genuinely improve fuel economy. Based on this insight, we estimate that tightening standards by one mile per gallon would have cost automakers just $9–$27 per vehicle in recent years. (JEL L51, L62, Q48)
abstract_zh: 估计监管成本十分困难。然而，当企业利用漏洞规避监管时，有时会间接地揭示其成本。我们将这一洞见应用于汽车燃油经济性标准。这些标准设有一项漏洞，即当汽车制造商为车辆配备灵活燃料能力时，可获得奖励。追求利润最大化的汽车制造商会使利用该漏洞的合规边际成本（可观测）与真正提高燃油经济性的策略的不可观测成本相等。基于这一洞见，我们估计，近年来将标准提高每加仑1英里，对汽车制造商而言每辆车的成本仅为9至27美元。（JEL L51, L62, Q48）

title: Open Space, Residential Property Values, and Spatial Context
Private Markets, Contracts, and Government Provision: What Explains the Organization of Local Waste and Recycling Markets?
abstract: The authors study determinants of market organization of local public services by an examination of one of the most visible services, residentialwaste management. Using a multinomial logit model and data for 1,000 U.S. communities, the authors explore the effects of political influence, voter ideology, environmental constraints, production costs, and contracting transaction costs on a community’s choice of service delivery options. They find that costs are significant in explaining communities’ choices. In contrast, few of the political variables are statistically significant. These results hold for both waste and recycling, providing further evidence that local governments emphasize costs when choosing between private and public provision.
abstract_zh: 作者通过考察最为显著的公共服务之一——居民垃圾管理，研究了地方公共服务市场组织形式的决定因素。利用多项Logit模型以及来自1000个美国社区的数据，作者考察了政治影响、选民意识形态、环境约束、生产成本以及合同交易成本对社区服务提供方式选择的影响。研究发现，成本在解释社区选择方面具有显著作用。相比之下，政治变量中只有少数具有统计显著性。这些结果对垃圾处理和回收均成立，进一步证明地方政府在选择私人提供还是公共提供时更重视成本。

title: Information Programs for Technology Adoption: The Case of Energy-Efficiency Audits
Prospects for Carbon Capture and Storage Technologies
venue: Annual Review of Environment and Resources
abstract: ▪ Abstract  Carbon capture and storage (CCS) technologies remove carbon dioxide from flue gases for storage in geologic formations or the ocean. We find that CCS is technically feasible, with current costs of about $200 to $250 per ton of carbon. Although currently a relatively expensive mitigation option, CCS could be attractive if we have a stringent carbon policy, if CCS turns out unexpectedly inexpensive relative to other options, or if it is otherwise desired to retain fossil fuels as part of the energy mix while reducing carbon emissions. Near-term prospects favor CCS for electric power plants and certain industrial sources with storage in depleted oil and gas reservoirs as opposed to aquifers. Deep aquifers may provide an attractive longer-term-storage option, whereas ocean storage poses greater technical and environmental uncertainty. CCS should be seriously considered for addressing climate change, alongside energy efficiency and carbon-free energy, although significant environmental, technical, and political uncertainties and obstacles remain.
abstract_zh: 摘要：碳捕集与封存（Carbon capture and storage, CCS）技术从烟气中移除二氧化碳，并将其封存于地质构造或海洋中。我们发现，CCS在技术上是可行的，目前成本约为每吨碳200至250美元。尽管目前它是相对昂贵的减排选择，但如果实施严格的碳政策，或者CCS的成本意外地低于其他选择，又或者出于在减排的同时保留化石燃料作为能源组合的一部分的需要，CCS仍可能具有吸引力。近期前景看好的是将CCS应用于电厂和某些工业排放源，并以枯竭的油气藏而非含水层作为封存场所。深部含水层可能提供一种具有吸引力的长期封存选择，而海洋封存则存在更大的技术与环境不确定性。CCS应与提高能效和无碳能源一道，被认真纳入应对气候变化的考虑，不过重大的环境、技术和政治不确定性及障碍依然存在。
